［Diary］Sun/Aug.23/2026
On our 3rd day in Kanazawa, we visited the 21st Century Art Museum and explored the art exhibit titled “Swimming Pool.” It was an awe-inspiring experience. Although it was challenging to secure a ticket for this entrance, we were rewarded with a fantastic experience.

［Diary］Sat/Aug.22/2026
On our 2nd day in Kanazawa, we drove to Nagisa Driveway. It’s a unique beach in Japan where you can drive on the sand. We were thrilled to see the ocean from the comfort of our car. After that, we headed to Bypass Leisure Land. I was overjoyed to finally find Tono Yabo 2!

Me in Tokyo: Jesus christ, can we please get a break from 95° heat?

Me in Kanazawa, with torrential rains and a landslide warning: not like that
